transcript.text: Good morning, everyone. I want to thank you all for joining this discussion. As you know, I've called us together because several participants have reported that feedback during Casey's process-improvement initiative has made collaboration tense across the operations, customer support, and product teams. As Director of Operations, I have the authority to retain or remove Casey as sponsor of this initiative, and I take that responsibility seriously. Before I make any decision, I need to follow my standard governance checklist, which includes a stakeholder review of observed repair efforts, contact boundaries, active commitments, and applicable workplace-relations procedures. I'd like to hear from each of you about what you've observed and any concerns you have. Let's start with what's been happening on the ground.
